description: If I buy this token on Arc, can I get out? For a token address or Uniswap v4 pool id on Arc: a real buy-then-sell round trip inside one eth_call through the pool hook (nothing spent) or, for ERC-20-USDC pools, both legs quoted. Returns whether the sell goes through, the round-trip cost, depth, and flags with reasons. The answer names its method. For up to 25 tokens in one call use arc_exit_check_bulk. PAID: $0.025 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1; no key, no sign-up) at https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/x402/arc-exit-check-bulk?ids=<token or pool id>. Over MCP this tool answers with that price and URL, not the data.

query.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex).

usdc.description: Test size in USDC, default 1, max 1000.

name: arc_exit_check
